notes.title: Version 1.1 - Exorcism ending update
notes.content:
Getting the exorcism ending was needlessly confusing, these changes should help players see the ending without having to restart a bunch.

[list]
[*] Updated exorcism ending hint to be more clear
[*] Updated exorcism room key to be easier to get
[*] Fixed bug where door would be off center when you opened it
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Updated exorcism ending hint to be more clear
